text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for tag v2.9.1-rc3 -> environments: us, eu, apac. Commit: 9f3b2d4. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary batch size: 5% per region. @alex @sophie @raj
alex: got it. watching prod dashboards and infra channels. starting probes. :eyes:
sophie: seeing ~0.3s p95 increase in EU LLM-serving pods already, not sure if related. no errors yet.
raj: APAC canary hit image pull errors on 3/10 hosts: "rpc: failed to fetch image". looks like registry timeouts. Investigating with infra team.
deploy-bot: US canary -> success. 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% rolled out (instances healthy). Duration: 12m.
maria: nice, US green. EU at 50% but p95 elevated as sophie said. rolling back EU to 25% and running extra probes.
sophie: EU logs show higher tokenization CPU on a subset of hosts. suspect kernel+cuda driver mismatch after the new runtime binary. filing issue, tagging hosts.
raj: APAC failing further at 40% with a mix of image pull + kube-sched latency. propose: pin APAC to v2.9.0 for now, continue US full, and hold EU at 25% until infra patch.
alex: agree with Raj. We should avoid a blanket rollback. Pin APAC to v2.9.0 (previous stable) and continue rollout in US; EU hold and swap to canary with cpu-bound probe. @maria can you coordinate pin?
maria: on it. creating patch rollout for APAC to v2.9.0 now. kubectl snippet: ```kubectl set image deploy/llm-runtime llm-runtime=registry/redwood/llm:2.9.0 -n prod-apac```
deploy-bot: APAC rollback/pin initiated: target tag v2.9.0. Rolling back 40% -> 0% for canary. Reason: registry/image pull + scheduling errors.
sophie: adding a temporary alert suppression for EU billing metrics to avoid noise. will also run a targeted trace on the tokenization stage.
raj: infra says registry spike on apac-eu-west mirrors due to CI artifact churn. They've disabled aggressive GC and are re-warming cache. ETA ~45m.
alex: plan summary: US rolled to v2.9.1-rc3 (done). EU held at 25% until we patch kernel/driver mismatch (devops owning). APAC pinned back to v2.9.0 pending registry stabilization. No global rollback.
maria: updating release notes: add APAC pin & explanation, list of affected hosts, rollback commands, and a follow-up action for a hotfix build.
deploy-bot: Rollout summary: US: success (100%), EU: partial (25% hold), APAC: pinned -> v2.9.0 (rolled back canary). Full logs and ops checklist: https://internal.redwood/internals/deploys/1852346789.
alex: ok, set a follow-up for a controlled retry for APAC after infra confirm. create a ticket and tag oncall. @raj can you post when registry mirror warmed? :thumbsup:
raj: will do. I'll post an update in ~40m or when mirrors are healthy.
maria: tagging release manager and legal for release note phrasing. Adding canary metrics to the postmortem even if it's not an incident.
sophie: thanks all. monitoring. :shipit:
